title: Integral lisse coefficient and reduction data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] with its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the continuous coefficient sheaves $A_X,E_X$ [def-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-coefficients] and constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define the underlying ring sheaf of $A_X$, its continuous quotient sheaves $(A/\varpi^{n+1})_X$, their pointwise reduction and transition maps, and constant sections. In the sheaf module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define multiplication by integral constants and the quotient predicate by its cokernel universal property (equivalently the sheaf tensor quotient [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]). Define integral lisse modules as the full subcategory of locally finite free $A_X$-modules, with rank zero and locally varying ranks allowed; define normalized positive reduction towers as inverse systems whose levels are restrictions of locally finite free quotient modules and whose adjacent transition is the quotient by $\varpi^{n+1}$. Define $\mathrm{IntegralLisseReductionEquivalence}(\ell,E,X)$ as the TYPE of coefficient identifications and reduction-equivalence data: finite constant identifications fixed on constant sections; the continuous coefficient cone fixed on every reduction and its limit property; the scalar cokernel properties; the localization cocone at $\ell$, fixed by $a\mapsto\ell^{-n}a$ in $E_X$, and its colimit property; an equivalence from integral lisse modules to normalized towers whose reduction components are the scalar quotients and whose inverse has the actual limit cone, with naturality on all morphisms and unit and counit fixed on every projection. This defines a type of such data and asserts no inhabitance.
